instruction: I use VLC in the background while doing other work, and I want it to stay out of the way. Can you configure VLC to start minimized to the system tray instead of showing the window?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's start minimized feature. The evaluator checks if the 'qt-startminimized' setting in VLC configuration is set to 1 (enabled). This is similar to the original task which modifies VLC settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) from the appropriate OS-specific location
Metric function correctly parses the config file, looking for 'qt-startminimized=' setting
Metric correctly handles commented lines (ignores lines starting with '#')
Metric correctly defaults to '0' if setting is not found in config
Expected value is semantically correct: '1' indicates the start minimized feature is enabled
Metric function correctly handles the expected parameter when type='rule' (accesses expected.get('expected_startminimized') directly)
Postconfig appropriately restarts VLC to ensure configuration changes are loaded and testable
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact setting required by the instruction (qt-startminimized)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts VLC config → metric verifies specific setting → expected value matches requirement
